# Current Partner collections

Our Founder Partners and Partners are key stakeholders in Art UK, representing the core body of UK art collections. We are grateful for their ongoing support and valuable feedback.

These collections support Art UK financially by paying an annual subscription. This allows them to access benefits detailed in our [partnership brochure](https://artuk.org/for-collections/partner-collections).
